classification.difficultyReason: Compare lengths and directions of parallel vectors on a square grid.

content.prompt: On the grid, some parallel vectors are shown. Name each vector in terms of $\underset{\sim}{v}$.

spec.description: Eight parallel diagonal arrows on an unlabelled 8 by 8 square grid. The reference arrow alone is labelled. A blank-grid template cannot express the supplied arrows and label.
spec.mathematics: Reference displacement is four cells right and four cells up. The seven other displacements are (-1,-1), (2,2), (-3,-3), (-4,-4), (8,8), (2,2), and (1,1).
spec.answerVisibility: Only the supplied vectors and reference label are visible.

answer.short: From top left to bottom right: $-\frac14\underset{\sim}{v}$, $\frac12\underset{\sim}{v}$, $-\frac34\underset{\sim}{v}$, $-\underset{\sim}{v}$, $2\underset{\sim}{v}$, $\frac12\underset{\sim}{v}$, $\frac14\underset{\sim}{v}$.
answer.worked:
The reference vector goes 4 cells right and 4 cells up. Compare each arrow's length with this reference; arrows in the opposite direction have a negative multiplier.

From top left to bottom right, the signed lengths in diagonal grid steps are $-1,2,-3,-4,8,2,1$. Dividing each by 4 gives $-\frac14\underset{\sim}{v}$, $\frac12\underset{\sim}{v}$, $-\frac34\underset{\sim}{v}$, $-\underset{\sim}{v}$, $2\underset{\sim}{v}$, $\frac12\underset{\sim}{v}$, $\frac14\underset{\sim}{v}$.
